checkpoints.question: Which shell context should run `docker ps`, and which should run `ros2 topic list -t` for the MAVROS graph?
checkpoints.model_answer: Run `docker ps` in the base-station or Duckiedrone shell. Run the ROS 2 topic command inside the `ros2-mavros` container shell entered with `docker exec`.

checkpoints.question: Why might `/mavros/imu/data` be valid when camera and ToF topics begin with `/ROBOT_NAME`?
checkpoints.model_answer: MAVROS uses a separate root-level path, while camera and ToF bridges use the robot-name prefix. The deployed stack and plugins determine the actual topic names.
